exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.
availability.purchase: Installing one is a single deterministic purchase costing exactly two units of its assigned specialized material.

effects.dive_target: nearest enemy entering the dive trigger range
effects.reserve_full_behavior: If the reserve is full, newly produced missiles launch normally at any target in acquisition range.

global_attack_rate_interaction.unaffected_timing: Missile movement, reserve life, and targeting

rules.text: Missiles enter an orbiting reserve around the mech instead of immediately choosing distant targets, up to eight stored missiles.
A reserve missile dives at the nearest enemy entering 6M, dealing 125% current Damage. If the reserve is full, newly produced missiles launch normally at any target in acquisition range.
Stored missiles persist until fired and retarget normally. They do not block enemy projectiles.
The branch banks damage during quiet traversal and releases it automatically when danger reaches the player.
